{
  "output_quality": {"score": 2, "reason": "Crude, murky rendering: the excavator reads as a giant dark navy monolith rather than a machine, the sloth's face is a tiny scribble with a magenta blob (vest/hat indistinguishable), and the mid-loop capture renders almost the entire scene blank white. Recognizable construction story, but sloppy and hard to parse."},
  "instruction_following": {"score": 3, "reason": "ViewBox 1200x800, standalone, no scripts/external refs, 4+ animated elements, sky/sun/clouds, dirt mounds, cone, caution stripe, toothed bucket and boom/stick present. But the high-vis vest is magenta, tracks/rollers merge into the dark body, hard hat illegible, and excavator barely reads as tracked; mid-loop frame loses the scene."},
  "creativity": {"score": 3, "reason": "Ambitious touches: crossing bird, rising exhaust puffs, sleepy 'Zzz', warning triangle, tree, warning stripe, dirt mounds. Charm is undercut by generic shapes and puzzling choices (magenta vest, caution stripe doubling as a floating red bar, clipped corner block) rather than polished invention."},
  "animation_fidelity": {"score": 2, "reason": "Frames show the arm swinging, clouds drifting and puffs rising, so SMIL runs, but at t=1500ms the whole backdrop/sun/ground/body fade to near-invisible white and only faint traces remain. Motion demonstrably breaks mid-loop instead of cycling cleanly; elements effectively vanish rather than animate in place."},
  "richness_detail": {"score": 3, "reason": "11 gradient defs, sun rays, layered cloud clusters, cone, rocks, arcs, tree, triangle and dirt mounds give decent layer density, but the right half is mostly empty, the ground is a flat brown wash, and the excavator is one huge flat dark shape lacking shading or mechanical detail."},
  "composition_aesthetics": {"score": 2, "reason": "Unbalanced: heavy dark mass crammed left, barren right third, sun and clouds okay but the dig action is cramped; a clipped dark bar sits in the top-left corner, clashing magenta accents, and the white-out frame destroys any sense of framing or polish."},
  "summary": "An ambitious but badly flawed animated sloth excavator: requirements are attempted and motion technically runs, yet the mid-loop frame collapses to near-blank and the drawing lacks readability, balance and polish."
}
